ports.label: USB-C · Thunderbolt 4
ports.info: Charging, external display and very fast data, all through one cable.
tips: Use this port for the charger or a docking station.
Look for the lightning-bolt symbol next to the port.

ports.label: USB-C · USB 3.2
ports.info: General USB-C port for phones, drives and adapters. It can also charge the laptop.
tips: If a USB-C monitor doesn't work here, try the Thunderbolt port instead.

ports.label: HDMI 2.1
ports.info: Connect an external monitor, TV or meeting-room projector.
specs: Carries audio as well as video
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.
No picture? Check the cable is pushed all the way in, then press Win + P again.

ports.label: USB-A 3.2
ports.info: For mice, keyboards, USB drives and older accessories.
specs: Can charge a phone while the laptop sleeps

ports.label: 3.5 mm audio jack
ports.info: Headphones, headsets with a microphone, or external speakers.
tips: If there's no sound, check the output device in the taskbar volume menu.

ports.label: Security lock slot
ports.info: Attach a cable lock to secure the laptop to a desk.

ports.label: USB-A 3.2
ports.info: For mice, keyboards, USB drives and older accessories.

ports.label: microSD card reader
ports.info: Read photos and files from microSD cards.
tips: Insert the card with the label facing up until it clicks.

ports.label: Battery & charging light
ports.info: Shows the battery and charging status.
specs: Blinking amber: battery or charger problem

ports.label: Power button + fingerprint
ports.info: Press to turn on or sleep. Touch to sign in with your fingerprint (Windows Hello).
tips: Hold for 10 seconds to force a shutdown if the laptop freezes.

ports.label: Webcam + privacy shutter
ports.info: 1080p webcam with an infrared sensor for face sign-in.
tips: Slide the shutter across to cover the camera when you're not using it.
